purpose: Recover the literal indexed-record addressing and field-read sequence preceding the GSP FILL XY geometry path.

observations.center_index_example: At frame 1791 the index stream includes 0x0001, 0x0011, 0x0021, ... at 16-byte address steps.
observations.center_record_example: At frame 1791 the record reader observes repeated 0x0130 words at addresses 0xFFFD0260, 0xFFFD0360, ...; this is a literal value observation, not a semantic label.
observations.input_dependence: Left and center forks select different index/data address streams and read counts from the same saved-state origin.
observations.instruction_fetch_caveat: Each result includes the instruction-fetch event at the filtered PC; data_reads excludes events whose address equals that PC.

interpretation: The GSP has an indexed 16-byte record walk feeding its geometry renderer. The record layout and addressing mechanism are now strong native-slice candidates; field ownership and whether the records represent road, object, or HUD primitives remain UNKNOWN.
